landing.heroSubtitle: An updated health history, a timeline that follows family life, and immediate support at medical visits. Centralizes exams, appointments, reminders and calendar — connected to Google Calendar and Outlook. Ava, our AI agent, helps families organize faster.
landing.heroNote: Features in use by real families. Copy and pricing still under review.

pains.title: You're not alone in this
pains.subtitle: Family health already demands attention. When records are scattered, the load grows — at visits, in emergencies, or when another caregiver needs context.

items.title: Visits without context
items.body: PDFs in email, lab results in another app, insurance card in a portal. When it matters, it's hard to remember what changed since the last visit.

items.title: Duplicate, confusing records
items.body: The same exam twice, vaccines with different names. That slows you and your clinician when building the clinical picture.

items.title: Family time lost to rework
items.body: Copying portal data, hunting authorizations and building folders for the doctor eats hours that could be rest or family time.

integrations.title: We connect to sources you already use
integrations.hint: Data flows automatically when the portal or service allows — without logging in every day.
integrations.disclaimer: Illustrative integration categories. Third-party brands belong to their owners; no endorsement or formal partnership is implied until officially announced.

export.title: Bring a clear summary to the visit
export.body: Clinical export with vaccines, recent exams, medications and timeline — real chart data so you arrive prepared for your health professional.

ava.title: Ava — your pocket companion at the visit
ava.body: Our AI agent supports families with everyday questions, organizes context from real chart data, and helps you prepare the conversation faster.

timeline.title: A timeline that follows the family
timeline.body: Visits, exams, vaccines and measurements in order — a continuous view of health for everyone you care for, adults and children.

gallery.title: Inside the platform
gallery.subtitle: Real AiyraCare screens — history, agenda, exams and Ava conversation.

landing.avaDisclaimer: Ava guides you using your chart and everyday questions. She does not perform exams, issue diagnoses, or replace medical evaluation or emergency care (SAMU 192).

steps.title: Centralize in minutes
steps.body: Add profiles for everyone you care for — kids, parents, yourself — and connect insurance and lab. The chart builds without spreadsheets.

steps.title: Arrive prepared
steps.body: Review what changed, export the summary and use Ava to list questions before the visit.

steps.title: Grow with the family
steps.body: Agenda, reminders and separate history per person — with access control and account deletion when you want.

features.title: Available today
features.subtitle: Product in continuous evolution. Below reflects what you can use now; clinical agents and more are on the roadmap.

items.title: Insurance and lab data
items.body: Automatic sync when the portal allows — less manual login and less rework.

items.title: Export for professionals
items.body: Deterministic clinical summary, PDF and temporary link to share with doctors and other professionals.

items.title: Ava — AI agent
items.body: Pocket companion at the visit: answers questions, organizes context and speeds up what you need before the appointment.

items.title: Agenda and calendar
items.body: Reminders, planned visits and sync with Google Calendar or Outlook.

items.title: Chart without duplicates
items.body: Review similar records and merge with confirmation — a clean chart for the family.

items.title: Privacy and LGPD
items.body: Terms, consent and account deletion. You control integrations and sensitive data.
